fees.title: Card payments
fees.body: When a customer pays an invoice by card, Luminexa takes a 0.5% platform fee. Stripe’s card processing fee is separate. Cash and e-transfer mark-as-paid still work without that platform fee.

faq.a: Yes. Finding providers, booking slots, messaging, and Gig wall posts are free for customers.
Luminexa Pro is $9.99 CAD per month after the free trial. That unlocks the provider dashboard and business tools.
Yes. New eligible businesses get a 30-day Pro trial — no card required to start. Add a payment method before the trial ends to keep Pro.

faq.q: Do you take a cut of every job?
faq.a: There is no booking commission on cash or e-transfer. On card invoice payments only, Luminexa takes 0.5% plus Stripe’s own processing fee.
Launch cities are Ottawa and Toronto, Ontario. Matching uses your address and each provider’s service area.
